next_source.implementation_path: Use CryptoQuant API/alerts: authenticate, pull high-value metrics first (exchange inflows/outflows, reserves, stablecoin flows, whale activity), normalize into DuckDB, score against price/news context. Start with 3-5 BTC/ETH metrics.
next_source.why: Highest signal density. Built for actionable on-chain alerts. Best next layer after Cointelegraph.

perplexity_output.unified_scoring_model: Two-stage score: (1) source-quality prior, (2) event impact score. Event impact = recency_weight x novelty x asset_relevance x source_prior x confidence, with historical source penalty.
perplexity_output.surprising_insight: The biggest edge is not adding more sources — it's separating lead indicators from narrative confirmation. CryptoQuant changes your view before the headline exists. It upgrades the model's priors rather than just adding another feed.
